_comment: PLACEHOLDERS (owner): Farcaster mini app manifest. Must be served from https://<YOUR_DOMAIN>/.well-known/farcaster.json at the DOMAIN ROOT (a GitHub Pages project subpath like /paper10k is not enough: use a custom domain or the user-site repo). accountAssociation must be generated and signed for that domain with your Farcaster account (Farcaster developer tools > Manifest).

miniapp.name: PAPER10K
